# Table paths that name no table fail, rather than resolve to another table.
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/lexical#table_names

# No default dataset is set, so a table name alone names no table.
SELECT 1 FROM t
=> error:

SELECT 1 FROM errors_table_paths_missing.t
=> error:

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_table_paths; SELECT 1 FROM errors_table_paths.missing
=> error:

SELECT 1 FROM a.b.c.d
=> error:

SELECT 1 FROM `a.b.c.d`
=> error:

SELECT 1 FROM `errors_table_paths..t`
=> error:
